readings.title: The Rebellion of Korah
readings.subtitle: A Challenge to Authority
readings.text: [Numbers 16:1] And Koraḥ, son of Yitsḥar, son of Qehath, son of Lewi, took both Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, and On, son of Peleth, sons of Re’uḇen, [2] and they rose up before Mosheh with some of the children of Yisra’el, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, called ones of the meeting, men of name. [3] And they assembled against Mosheh and against Aharon, and said to them, “Enough of you! For all the congregation are set-apart, all of them, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is in their midst. Why then do you lift yourselves up above the assembly of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>?” [4] And when Mosheh heard, he fell on his face, [5] and he spoke to Koraḥ and all his company, saying, “Tomorrow morning <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall make known who are <dn>His</dn>, and who is set-apart, and bring him near to <dn>Him</dn>. And let <dn>Him</dn> bring near to <dn>Him</dn> the one <dn>He</dn> chooses. [6] Do this: Take censers, Koraḥ and all your company, [7] and put fire in them and put incense in them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> tomorrow. And it shall be that the man whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses is the set-apart one. Enough of you, sons of Lewi!” [8] And Mosheh said to Koraḥ, “Hear now, you sons of Lewi: [9] Is it little to you that the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’el has separated you from the congregation of Yisra’el, to bring you near to <dn>Himself</dn>, to perform the service of the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and to stand before the congregation to serve them, [10] and that <dn>He</dn> has brought you near to <dn>Himself</dn>, and all your brothers, the sons of Lewi, with you? And do you seek the priesthood as well? [11] Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And Aharon, what is he that you grumble against him?” [12] And Mosheh sent to call Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, but they said, “We are not coming up! [13] Is it little that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you would even seize total rule over us? [14] Also, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Would you bore out the eyes of these men? We are not coming up!” [15] And Mosheh was very wroth, and said to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I done harm to any of them.” [16] And Mosheh said to Koraḥ, “You and all your company, be before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> tomorrow, you and they, and Aharon. [17] And take each one his censer, and you shall put incense in them, and each one shall bring his censer before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, two hundred and fifty censers, and you and Aharon, each one his censer.” [18] So each one took his censer, and they put fire in them, and put incense in them, and stood at the door of the Tent of Appointment with Mosheh and Aharon. [19] And Koraḥ assembled all the congregation against them at the door of the Tent of Appointment. Then the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> appeared to all the congregation.

readings.title: The Divine Judgment
readings.subtitle: The Earth Opens
readings.text: [Numbers 16:20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and to Aharon, saying, [21] <dq>“Separate yourselves from among this congregation, so that <dn>I</dn> consume them in a moment.”</dq> [22] But they fell on their faces, and said, “O <dn>El</dn>, <dn>Elohim</dn> of the spirits of all flesh! When one man sins, are <dn>You</dn> wroth with all the congregation?” [23] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [24] <dq>“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Move away from the encampment of Koraḥ, Dathan, and Aḇiram.’ ”</dq> [25] So Mosheh rose up and went to Dathan and Aḇiram, and the elders of Yisra’el followed him. [26] And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Please withdraw from the tents of these wrong men! Do not touch whatever belongs to them, lest you be swept away in all their sins.” [27] So they moved away from the encampment of Koraḥ, Dathan, and Aḇiram on every side. And Dathan and Aḇiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, and their sons, and their little children. [28] And Mosheh said, “By this you know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sent me to do all these works, that they are not from my own heart. [29] If these men die as all men do, or if they are visited as all men are visited, then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has not sent me. [30] But if <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> creates what is new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into She’ol, then you shall know that these men have scorned <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [31] And it came to be, as he ended speaking all these words, that the ground under them split apart, [32] and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the men with Koraḥ, with all their goods. [33] So they and all those with them went down alive into She’ol, and the earth closed over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly. [34] And all Yisra’el who were round about them fled at their cry, for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!” [35] And a fire came out from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.

readings.title: Atonement Amidst Plague
readings.subtitle: Standing Between the Living and the Dead
readings.text: [Numbers 16:36] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [37] <dq>“Say to El’azar, son of Aharon the priest, to pick up the censers out of the burning, for they are set-apart, and scatter the fire some distance away.</dq> [38] <dq>The censers of these men who sinned against their own lives, let them be made into beaten-out plates as a covering for the altar. Because they brought them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, therefore they are set-apart. And let them be a sign to the children of Yisra’el.”</dq> [39] So El’azar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned had brought, and they were beaten out as a covering for the altar – [40] a remembrance to the children of Yisra’el that no stranger who is not of the seed of Aharon should come near to offer incense before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, lest he be like Koraḥ and his company, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said to him through the hand of Mosheh. [41] But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Yisra’el grumbled against Mosheh and against Aharon, saying, “You have killed the people of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [42] And it came to be, when the congregation had assembled against Mosheh and against Aharon, that they turned toward the Tent of Appointment. And see, the cloud covered it, and the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> appeared. [43] Then Mosheh and Aharon came before the Tent of Appointment. [44] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [45] <dq>“Rise up from the midst of this congregation, so that <dn>I</dn> consume them in a moment.”</dq> And they fell on their faces. [46] So Mosheh said to Aharon, “Take a censer and put fire in it from the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the plague has begun.” [47] And Aharon took it as Mosheh commanded, and ran into the midst of the assembly. And see, the plague had begun among the people. And he put on the incense and made atonement for the people. [48] And he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stopped. [49] And those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on account of Koraḥ. [50] Then Aharon returned to Mosheh at the door of the Tent of Appointment, for the plague had stopped.

readings.title: The Budding of Aharon’s Rod
readings.subtitle: Confirmation of the Priesthood
readings.text: [Numbers 17:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’el, and take from them a rod from each father’s house, all their leaders according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.</dq> [3] <dq>And write Aharon’s name on the rod of Lewi. For there is one rod for the head of each father’s house.</dq> [4] <dq>And you shall place them in the Tent of Appointment before the Witness, where <dn>I</dn> meet with you.</dq> [5] <dq>And it shall be that the rod of the man whom <dn>I</dn> choose buds, and <dn>I</dq> shall rid <dn>Myself</dn> of the grumblings of the children of Yisra’el, which they grumble against you.”</dq> [6] So Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’el, and each of their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. And the rod of Aharon was among their rods. [7] And Mosheh placed the rods before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the Tent of the Witness. [8] And it came to be on the next day that Mosheh went into the Tent of the Witness, and see, the rod of Aharon, of the house of Lewi, had budded, and brought forth buds, and blossomed, and yielded ripe almonds! [9] Then Mosheh brought out all the rods from before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to all the children of Yisra’el. And they looked and each man took his rod. [10] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Bring Aharon’s rod back before the Witness, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, so that you put an end to their grumblings against <dn>Me</dn>, lest they die.”</dq> [11] And Mosheh did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded him, so he did. [12] And the children of Yisra’el spoke to Mosheh, saying, “See, we shall expire, we shall perish, we shall all perish! [13] Anyone who comes near, who comes near to the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, dies. Shall we be utterly consumed?”

readings.title: Duties of Priests and Lewites
readings.subtitle: The Guarding of the Sanctuary
readings.text: [Numbers 18:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Aharon, <dq>“You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the crookedness against the set-apart place, and you and your sons with you shall bear the crookedness against your priesthood.</dq> [2] <dq>But bring with you your brothers of the tribe of Lewi, the tribe of your father, to be joined with you and serve you, while you and your sons with you are before the Tent of the Witness.</dq> [3] <dq>And they shall guard your charge and the charge of all the Tent, only they do not come near the furnishings of the set-apart place and the altar, lest both they and you die.</dq> [4] <dq>And they shall be joined with you and guard the charge of the Tent of Appointment, for all the service of the Tent, but a stranger does not come near you.</dq> [5] <dq>And you shall guard the charge of the set-apart place and the charge of the altar, so that there be no more wrath on the children of Yisra’el.</dq> [6] <dq>And see, <dn>I Myself</dn> have taken your brothers the Lewites from the midst of the children of Yisra’el, given to you as a gift from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to perform the service of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [7] <dq>But you and your sons with you shall guard your priesthood for everything at the altar and behind the veil, and you shall serve. <dn>I</dn> have given your priesthood as a gift of service, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”</dq>

readings.title: The Priest’s Portion
readings.subtitle: A Covenant of Salt
readings.text: [Numbers 18:8] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Aharon, <dq>“And see, <dn>I Myself</dn> have also given you the charge of <dn>My</dn> contributions, all the set-apart gifts of the children of Yisra’el. <dn>I</dn> have given them to you and your sons as a portion, an everlasting law.</dq> [9] <dq>This is yours of the most set-apart gifts, from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering and every sin offering and every guilt offering of theirs which they render to <dn>Me</dn>, is most set-apart for you and for your sons.</dq> [10] <dq>In a most set-apart place you eat it. Every male eats it. It is set-apart to you.</dq> [11] <dq>And this is yours: the contribution of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yisra’el. <dn>I</dq> <dq>have given them to you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as an everlasting law. Everyone who is clean in your house eats it.</dq> [12] <dq>All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine and the grain – the first-fruits which they give to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – <dn>I</dn> have given them to you.</dq> [13] <dq>The first-fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, are yours. Everyone who is clean in your house eats it.</dq> [14] <dq>Everything dedicated in Yisra’el is yours.</dq> [15] <dq>Everyone opening a womb of all flesh, which they bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, whether man or beast, is yours. But the first-born of man you shall certainly ransom, and the first-born of unclean beasts you shall ransom.</dq> [16] <dq>And their ransom price, learned from a month old, you shall ransom according to your valuation, five sheqels of silver according to the sheqel of the set-apart place, which is twenty bērahs.</dq> [17] <dq>Only, the first-born of a cow, or the first-born of a sheep, or the first-born of a goat, you shall not ransom, they are set-apart. Sprinkle their blood on the altar, and burn their fat as an offering made by fire for a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [18] <dq>And their flesh is yours, as the wave breast and the right shoulder are yours.</dq> [19] <dq>All the contributions of the set-apart gifts, which the children of Yisra’el present to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have given to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as an everlasting law. It is a covenant of salt forever before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with you and your seed with you.”</dq>

readings.title: The Inheritance of Lewi
readings.subtitle: The Tithe of the Tithe
readings.text: [Numbers 18:20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Aharon, <dq>“You are not to have an inheritance in their land, nor have any portion in their midst. <dn>I</dn> am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Yisra’el.</dq> [21] <dq>And see, <dn>I</dn> have given the children of Lewi all the tithes in Yisra’el as an inheritance in return for the service which they are performing, the service of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [22] <dq>And the children of Yisra’el should no longer come near the Tent of Appointment, lest they bear sin and die.</dq> [23] <dq>And the Lewites shall perform the service of the Tent of Appointment, and they shall bear their crookedness – an everlasting law throughout your generations. And among the children of Yisra’el they are to have no inheritance.</dq> [24] <dq>For the tithes of the children of Yisra’el, which they present as a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have given to the Lewites as an inheritance. That is why <dn>I</dn> said to them, ‘Among the children of Yisra’el they are to have no inheritance.’ ”</dq> [25] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [26] <dq>“And speak to the Lewites and say to them, ‘When you take from the children of Yisra’el the tithes which <dn>I</dn> have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall present a contribution of it to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a tithe of the tithe.</dq> [27] <dq>And your contribution shall be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing-floor and as the filling of the winepress.</dq> [28] <dq>So you shall also present a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Yisra’el, and you shall give the contribution of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from it to Aharon the priest.</dq> [29] <dq>From all your gifts you shall present every contribution of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from all the best of them, its set-apart part.’</dq> [30] <dq>And you shall say to them, ‘When you have presented the best of it, then the rest shall be reckoned to the Lewites as the product of the threshing-floor and as the product of the winepress.</dq> [31] <dq>And you shall eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward for your service in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [32] <dq>And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have presented the best of it. And do not profane the set-apart gifts of the children of Yisra’el, lest you die.’ ”</dq>
